name: Rajecké Teplice (Slovakia)
description: Ten equal horizontal stripes of yellow, yellow, blue, blue, white, white, blue, blue, yellow and yellow, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature R-2/1991.
